title: Then & Now
shareTitle: Then & Now — A History Detective Adventure
description: Open a watercolor time-travel book, sort familiar objects into long ago or today, and match older tools with the modern tools that do the same job.
learningGoals: Use then and now as concrete time concepts
Connect changing tools by the job they share
Build early history vocabulary through picture, touch, and narration
interactionModel: drag or tap-tap objects into large Then and Now pockets, then choose a modern tool that shares an older tool's job
feedbackModel: correct choices settle into the storybook with spoken time language and a paired reveal; misses softly return with one warm retry prompt; each adventure fills a Time Traveler Gallery

modes.title: Long Ago or Today
modes.skill: sort familiar tools by whether they belong to long ago or today

modes.title: Same Job, New Tool
modes.skill: connect an older tool with a modern tool that serves the same purpose
